title: Homo Hotel Happy Hour at Hilton Garden Inn South (Second Friday!)
description: Road trip, Tulsa! Labor Day stole our First Friday, so September's Homo Hotel Happy Hour moves to the SECOND Friday: September 11, 6 to 8 PM at the Hilton Garden Inn Tulsa South (8202 S 100th E Ave, near 81st and Mingo, right off Highway 169). We're taking the party to South Tulsa this month, and the hotel is throwing in pool access. The charity raffle benefits Council Oak Men's Chorale, Tulsa's gay men's chorus. Free to attend, and everyone is welcome. Grab your people, point the car south, and come make a night of it. See you there.
